'''AR-G0''' was a [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]] owned by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Beryl Thorne]] operating out of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Thorne named AR-G0 the second in command of her operation on Taris after suffering the losses of many contacts to [[rakghoul]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

AR-G0 was separated from Thorne escaping [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] when infighting between the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] broke out.<ref name="TOR" />
